email.subject1: a signal play for Exiger public sector
email.body1:
Jonathan, saw Exiger won the $919M GSA blanket purchase agreement and is bringing 1Exiger to more federal buyers.

A win that size usually opens more agency accounts than the team can cover before the window closes, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Exiger's public-sector motion off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jonathan, quick follow-up on Exiger's public-sector pipeline.

After a marquee GSA award, the target on agency pipeline climbs fast. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Exiger's public-sector team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jonathan, last bit of proof for Exiger.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Exiger's public-sector reply rate likely compares to other govtech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jonathan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling public-sector pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a major award, and I know mobilizing agency coverage is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a public-sector motion? I will tailor it to Exiger either way.
